Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
# clean old configs befre config package

[string]$Path = "#{CustomArgosyDirectory}"

[string]$ConfigPath = Join-Path $Path "_CONFIGS"

Write-Host "CLEAN CONFIGS ::::"

if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Path)) {
Write-Host "Path is empty !!!"
exit
}

Write-Host "DELETE : " $ConfigPath\*

Remove-Item -Path $ConfigPath\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

#SilentlyContinue will write error to $Error var, so show the error
$Error

#{{YourConfiguredDropFolderPath}}\{{Environment}}\{{ProjectName}}\{{Release}}
#C:\_OFFLINE_DROP\MORH\TEST\Argosy\2023.3.15.2-REL-2

$offlineDrop = "C:\_OFFLINE_DROP"
$templateDir = "C:\_OFFLINE_DROP\_OFFLINERUNNER"
$zipFolder = "C:\_OFFLINE_DROP\_ZIPEDOFFLINEDROP"
$batFile = "INSTALL.bat"

write-host $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Deployment.Tenant.Name"]
write-host $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
write-host $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Project.Name"]
write-host $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Release.Number"]


$relDir = Join-Path -Path $offlineDrop -ChildPath $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Deployment.Tenant.Name"]
$relDir = Join-Path -Path $relDir -ChildPath $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
$relDir = Join-Path -Path $relDir -ChildPath $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Project.Name"]
$relDir = Join-Path -Path $relDir -ChildPath $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Release.Number"]

write-host "Release DIR : " $relDir


cd $relDir
$offRunDir = Join-Path -Path $relDir -ChildPath OfflineRunner

write-host "Copy OfflineRunner"
cd $templateDir
Copy-Item -Path $templateDir -Recurse -Destination $offRunDir

write-host "Copy INSTALL.bat"
Copy-Item -Path $batFile -Destination $relDir

#out vars
Set-OctopusVariable -name "RelDir" -value $relDir

$zipName = $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Deployment.Tenant.Name"]
$zipName = $zipName + "-" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
$zipName = $zipName + "-" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Project.Name"]
$zipName = $zipName + "-" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Release.Number"]
$zipName = $zipName + ".zip"

Set-OctopusVariable -name "ZipNameFileOnly" -value $zipName

$zipName = Join-Path -Path $zipFolder -ChildPath $zipName

Set-OctopusVariable -name "ZipName" -value $zipName

#write vars to text file for Offline Runner
#del first
$octovarsfile = Join-Path -Path $offRunDir -ChildPath "OctoVars.txt"
write-host "Write vars to " $octovarsfile
if (Test-Path $octovarsfile) {Remove-Item $octovarsfile}

New-Item -Path $offRunDir -Name "OctoVars.txt" -ItemType "file"
Add-Content -Path $octovarsfile -Value "`n",$OctopusParameters["Octopus.Deployment.Tenant.Name"]
Add-Content -Path $octovarsfile -Value "`n",$OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
Add-Content -Path $octovarsfile -Value "`n",$OctopusParameters["Octopus.Project.Name"]
Add-Content -Path $octovarsfile -Value "`n",$OctopusParameters["Octopus.Release.Number"]

$zipNameFile  = $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Action[AddOfflineRunner].Output.ZipNameFileOnly"]
$zipPathFile  = $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Action[AddOfflineRunner].Output.ZipName"]

$ftpUplFile = "ftp://support.laus.hr/octopus/wwwroot/packages/" + $zipNameFile

write-host "FTP UPLOAD file: " $zipPathFile
write-host "FTP UPLOAD TO: " $ftpUplFile

$client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
$client.Credentials = New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential("support.laus.hr|ftp_support", "q47Q!3R2sLAhQWQDbXXh")
$client.UploadFile($ftpUplFile, $zipPathFile)

write-host "FTP DONE."
